projects.name: Rooftop unit replacement
projects.why: The new unit is on site, but the crane to lift it onto the roof is not booked.
projects.next: Call the crane company and lock in a lift date.
projects.blocker: The crane company to confirm a lift date.

projects.name: Boiler inspection before heating season
projects.why: The county inspector moved the visit twice, and the heat goes on there on October 1.
projects.next: Ask the inspector's office for a firm date this week.
projects.blocker: The county inspector's office to give a new date.

projects.name: Move to new billing software
projects.why: The switch is set for October 1, but last year's invoices are not exported yet.
projects.next: Chase the export and pick a backup date.
projects.blocker: The old billing company to send last year's invoices.

projects.name: Hire two service technicians
projects.why: One offer is out. The second opening has no candidates, and the busy season starts in three weeks.
projects.next: Post the second opening at the technical college.

projects.name: Warehouse reorganization
projects.why: Nobody owns it and it has no date, so nothing has moved in three weeks.
projects.next: Pick an owner and a Saturday for it.

projects.name: Kitchen exhaust upgrade
projects.why: The parts arrived on Tuesday, and the install is set for the diner's closed day.
projects.next: Confirm Monday's install time with the diner.

projects.name: Fall furnace tune-up campaign
projects.why: The postcards are printed, and 214 customers are on the mailing list.

projects.name: New service van
projects.why: The dealer confirmed the van, and the shelving and logo wrap are booked.
projects.next: Sign the finance papers with the dealer.

projects.name: Heat pump retrofit, Building C
projects.why: The equipment is ordered, and the tenants know their dates.
projects.next: Confirm the delivery date with the supplier.

projects.name: Online booking page
projects.why: The booking form works. The page still needs photos of the team.
projects.next: Book a photo session with the team.

changes.text: Boiler inspection for Kettering Senior Living went from on track to late.
Rooftop unit replacement for Oakwood Middle School went from at risk to late.
Move to new billing software went from on track to at risk.
Kitchen exhaust upgrade for Riverside Diner is back on track now that the parts arrived.
New service van is back on track after the dealer confirmed it.
Online booking page was added, with no due date yet.
Ladder and roof safety training was finished on Tuesday.
